sources.title: rasyosef/RoBERTa-Amharic-Embed-Base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: RoBERTa Amharic Embed Base This is a sentence-transformers model finetuned from rasyosef/roberta-base-amharic. It maps sentences & paragraphs to a 768-dimensional dense vector space and can be used for semantic textual similarity, semantic search, paraphrase mining, text classification, clustering, and more. Model Details Model Description

sources.title: rasyosef/roberta-base-amharic · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: roberta-base-amharic This model has the same architecture as xlm-roberta-base and was pretrained from scratch using the Amharic subsets of the oscar, mc4, and amharic-sentences-corpus datasets, on a total of 290 Million tokens. The tokenizer was trained from scratch on the same text corpus, and had a vocabulary size of 32k.

sources.snippet: ColBERT-Roberta-Amharic-Base This is a PyLate model finetuned from rasyosef/roberta-base-amharic. It maps sentences & paragraphs to sequences of 128-dimensional dense vectors and can be used for semantic textual similarity using the MaxSim operator.
